dct_description_sm: As part of the ArcticNet and BOND (Sentinel North) research programs, the primary goal of this project is to achieve greater spatial and temporal resolution of surface concentrations of DMS in contrasting environments (open water, ice, marginal ice) of the Canadian Arctic Archipelago to characterize the distribution of oceanic DMS on a regional scale. This dataset is used to study possible correlations between DMS concentrations and physico-chemical and biological parameters of the environment (salinity, temperature, chl a, solar radiation) as well as the dynamics of ice.
dct_title_s: Fine-scale time series of surface dimethylsulfide concentrations across ice-covered and ice-free waters of the Canadian Arctic Archipelago in summer, 2018
